title: [IMP2-11] A new device has no source for the user's Spaces and endpoints
description: Review finding IMP2-11: A new device has no source for the user's Spaces and endpoints (lens IMP2). Location: spec/02-identity.md:496-509; spec/03-spaces.md:315; spec/04-access-control.md:88. Fix: Endpoints come only from a `SpaceInvite`, a `SpaceAd` or the owner's DID document (03:315), and the self-group contents (02:498-502) carry none of them. Add a single-author self-group record that lists each Space's genesis CID and `spaceEndpoint`. The existing device sends it before step 3 of 02:507. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
